description: This file contains a suite of stress and concurrency tests for the ConcurrentLruCache class, focusing on thread safety, cache integrity under high load, and correctness of cache operations such as get, add, update, remove, and clear. It includes multiple test cases with multi-threaded execution to verify cache behavior under extreme conditions.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruCacheSoakTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple concurrency and stress tests for the ConcurrentLruCache implementation, verifying thread safety, cache integrity, and correct behavior under high load.

classes.name: Threaded
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to run actions concurrently across multiple threads, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous execution.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruCacheIntegrityChecker
classes.description: A static class providing validation methods to ensure the internal consistency of a ConcurrentLruCache instance, including queue sizes and cache contents.

classes.name: RepeatAttribute
classes.description: A custom Xunit data attribute to repeat a test multiple times for robustness.
